request.query: The degree in a variable of the determinant of Hasse derivatives is bounded by the size times the degree of the polynomial.

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_pow_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : ℕ),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (p ^ n) ≤ n * MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p

items.name: Polynomial.degree_derivative_lt
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, p ≠ 0 → (Polynomial.derivative p).degree < p.degree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_derivative_le
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (Polynomial.derivative p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - 1

items.name: MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_totalDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (f : MvPolynomial σ R) (i : σ),
  MvPolynomial.degreeOf i f ≤ f.totalDegree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_det_X_add_C_le
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : CommRing α] (A B : Matrix n n α),
  (Polynomial.X • A.map ⇑Polynomial.C + B.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card n
